title: Access ODS data from the ODT FHIR API
text: install package using renv: fetch ODS organisation details API: get original data back extra columns added right. data holds codes another source, map ODS codes table first:
code: renv::install("nhs-england-patient-safety/odsdata") # the API key is read from an environment variable Sys.setenv(ods_key = "your-key-here")  orgs <- dplyr::tibble(org_code = c("RR8", "RX1", "NQV", "RWX", NA))  fetch_and_join_ods(data = orgs, org_code_col = "org_code") mapping <- dplyr::tibble(   local_code = c("A1", "A2", "B1", "A3"),   ods_code   = c("RR8", "RX1", "NQV", "RWX") )  sites <- dplyr::tibble(code = c("A1", "A2", "B1", "A3", NA))  map_to_ods_codes(data = sites, mapping = mapping, by = c(code = "local_code"))

title: Access ODS data from the ODT FHIR API
text: Organisation Data Terminology (ODT) API FHIR API: REST API fixed set “resources”, path. holds Organisation Data Service (ODS) data. base URL : odsdata uses /CodeSystem/$lookup. CodeSystem table codes properties attached one. use two: organisation CodeSystem, name, country, primary role code NHS England region code (region names organisations , come well) role CodeSystem, turn role code like RO197 NHS TRUST API holds lot , added later.
code: https://api.service.nhs.uk/organisation-data-terminology-api/fhir /fhir ├── /Organization/{code}        one organisation: name, address, roles, status ├── /Organization?...           search for organisations ├── /OrganizationAffiliation    relationships between organisations ├── /CodeSystem/$lookup         look up one code, with extra properties  <- used by odsdata ├── /ValueSet/$expand           pull a filtered batch of codes ├── /List/{id}                  records that have been deleted └── /metadata                   what the server supports

title: Access ODS data from the ODT FHIR API
text: three share arguments: include_cols: ODS columns add (org_name, org_type, org_country, org_region_code, org_region). english_only: drop non-English organisations, keeping country. on_missing: codes can’t resolved. "warn" (default) warns carries , "error" stops, "silent" says nothing. covers codes ODS can’t find, codes mapping table can’t resolve (see ), failed requests. every request fails, function stops whatever on_missing set . data already holds ODS codes, start fetch_and_join_ods(). fetch_and_join_ods() following, order: Looks unique, non-missing code , however often appears data. Codes can’t found reported according on_missing. Adds role region names asked , one lookup per distinct code. english_only = TRUE, drops rows organisations whose country England. Joins columns asked back data. Rows missing code get missing values. Lookups run parallel 250 codes. package waits requests stay inside API’s rate limit.

title: Fetch and join ODS organisation data to a dataset — fetch_and_join_ods
text: data dataframe containing organisation codes org_code_col Column containing organisation code (e.g., 'ReporterOrganisationCode', 'RP07') english_only Logical. Filter include English (N/) organisations include_cols Character. ODS columns add. Default adds . Choose : org_name, org_type, org_country, org_region_code, org_region; dates org_legal_start, org_legal_end, org_operational_start org_operational_end; org_successors, list column holding codes organisation's immediate successors (empty none). legal end date shows organisation closed. ODS often gives start dates default 1 April 1 October. on_missing Character. codes found ODS request fails: "warn" (default) warns carries , "error" stops, "silent" nothing. Missing codes get NA values unless "error" used. every request fails, function stops regardless.
